responsibility: Implements MinGW’s Microsoft-runtime format checking definitions for the C-family front ends. It declares the `ms_printf`, `ms_scanf`, and `ms_strftime` format kinds, including their length modifiers, flag tables, conversion-specifier type expectations, and default override mappings from standard `printf`/`scanf`/`strftime`, and it initializes pedantic handling of MS-only width modifiers under `-Wpedantic-ms-format`, thereby driving GCC’s `-Wformat` diagnostics for MSVCRT-style formats.
